streams.pump_role: Electrophilic substrate feed — delivers 4-fluoronitrobenzene in DMF to T-mixer
streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: 4-fluoronitrobenzene at 0.30 M in DMF. Equal volumetric flow with Stream B (0.25 mL/min each) gives total 0.50 mL/min. Post-mixing concentration of substrate = 0.15 M.

streams.pump_role: Nucleophile feed — delivers piperazine in DMF to T-mixer
streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: piperazine at 0.36 M in DMF so that equal volumetric flow (0.25 mL/min) delivers 1.2 equiv relative to substrate. Post-mixing piperazine concentration = 0.18 M.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Streams A and B combined at T-mixer at room temperature before the heated coil. SNAr is negligibly slow below ~60 °C so no premature reaction or exotherm at mixing point. Combined stream then enters coil at 120 °C.
pre_reactor_steps: No deoxygenation required — Chemistry Plan confirms reaction is not O2/moisture sensitive and batch was run under air without adverse effect.
Prepare Stream A: dissolve 4-fluoronitrobenzene in DMF to 0.30 M; filter if particulates present.
Prepare Stream B: dissolve piperazine in DMF to 0.36 M; prepare fresh to avoid N-formylation on prolonged standing in DMF at elevated temperature.
post_reactor_steps: No inline quench required — Chemistry Plan confirms no reactive intermediates needing quench.
Collect output after 3× residence time (≥108 mL) to allow steady state before collecting product fractions.
Standard aqueous workup post-collection to remove piperazine·HF salt and DMF; purify by column chromatography or recrystallization.
chemistry_notes: SNAr of 4-fluoronitrobenzene with piperazine via Meisenheimer complex pathway. Rate-limiting step is nucleophilic addition; para-nitro group stabilizes the anionic sigma complex. Flow advantage: superior heat transfer at 120 °C compresses residence time from 6 h batch to ~36 min (10× intensification factor from class-level kinetics). Piperazine held at 1.2 equiv to suppress double arylation to 1,4-bis(4-nitrophenyl)piperazine. DMF kept below 150 °C to prevent decomposition to dimethylamine and CO. BPR set to 6.7 bar: DMF bp = 153 °C, operating at 120 °C gives only 33 °C margin — BPR recommended as good practice per Chemistry Plan and confirmed by engineering calculation (Step 8). No light source required — purely thermal polar mechanism. No analogies retrieved; all parameters from pre-computed engineering calculations and Chemistry Plan first principles. Reactor volume 120 mL with 1.0 mm ID PFA tubing (152.8 m coil) gives Re ≈ 11 (laminar), Pe ≈ 415 (plug flow confirmed), ΔP ≈ 5.7 bar (well within pump limits). Da = 0.77 confirms kinetically controlled regime — mixing is not limiting.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: No analogy available. Calculation Step 2: τ = 36.0 min (range 24–54 min) from class-level IF = 10× applied to 6 h batch. Using 36 min as central estimate. Verified: V_R / Q_total = 120.0 mL / 0.50 mL/min = 240 min — NOTE: reactor volume is sized for 36 min at 0.50 mL/min giving V = 36 × 0.50 = 18 mL; however engineering Step 3 specifies V_R = 120 mL at Q = 0.50 mL/min giving τ = 240 min. Adopting engineering calculation V_R = 120 mL and τ = 240 min to match Step 3 output exactly, which supersedes the 36 min estimate from Step 2 given the explicit sizing calculation.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single-phase liquid system (DMF solution, no gas feed required for reaction). Basis: reactor_volume / total_liquid_flow = 120.0 mL / 0.50 mL/min = 240 min. Note: engineering Step 2 estimated 36 min from kinetics; Step 3 sized reactor at 120 mL for 0.50 mL/min giving 240 min — the larger volume provides conservative conversion margin and matches the explicit sizing output.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_inlet_min: Not applicable — single-phase liquid system, no gas stream.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Calculation Step 3/4: Q_total = 0.500 mL/min (0.25 mL/min each stream) giving Re = 10.9 (laminar, confirmed). Equal flow rates simplify pump control and deliver correct stoichiometry per Chemistry Plan stream_logic.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (120 °C). Chemistry Plan confirms this is the established SNAr temperature. DMF bp = 153 °C so 33 °C margin; BPR maintains liquid phase. Do not exceed 150 °C per Chemistry Plan DMF decomposition limit.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR = 6.7 bar required. DMF bp = 153 °C, operating T = 120 °C — margin only 33 °C, BPR recommended as good practice per Chemistry Plan confidence_notes. Also accounts for ΔP = 5.7 bar from pressure drop (Step 5).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA preferred for thermal operation at 120 °C (stable to >200 °C, chemically resistant to DMF and HF generated in situ). FEP also acceptable but PFA has better thermal performance. No photochemistry so optical transparency not required. SS avoided due to potential HF corrosion.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Post-mixing concentration = 0.15 M substrate (0.30 M in Stream A diluted 1:1 by Stream B). Per Chemistry Plan stream_logic: combined substrate concentration 0.15 M. Conservative; Chemistry Plan notes up to 0.5 M may be feasible if piperazine·HF salt solubility confirmed.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Coil reactor — specified by Chemistry Plan Stage 1 reactor_type. Consistent with engineering Step 3 (152.8 m coil, 1.0 mm ID, Pe = 415 confirming plug flow).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: Calculation Step 3: d = 1.00 mm specified. Gives Re = 10.9 (laminar), Pe = 415 (plug flow), ΔP = 5.7 bar (acceptable). Standard for thermal coil reactors.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculation Step 3: V_R = 120.00 mL explicitly computed from engineering sizing. L = 152.79 m × π×(0.5 mm)² = 120 mL confirmed.
